doc: Maintained configuration contract for apps/edge-sentinel. Every environment variable the README documents must appear here with the component that actually reads it, and every entry here must still resolve in that component's code: apps/edge-sentinel/test_readme_config_claims.py enforces both directions, so a variable cannot be documented without being consumed and cannot stop being consumed without being noticed. `owner` is `edge-sentinel` for a variable this app reads itself and `agentic-os` for a kernel variable this app inherits. It records what the code does, not an aspiration; a new variable is added here in the change that reads it.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_LAPI_URL
variables.purpose: CrowdSec Local API base for reading decisions.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_BOUNCER_KEY
variables.purpose: X-Api-Key for GET /v1/decisions.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_CONTAINER
variables.purpose: Container name used for cscli exec (alerts, ban enforcement).

variables.name: CROWDSEC_FRONT_URL
variables.purpose: Link target for the dashboard's CrowdSec metrics link.

variables.name: PORT
variables.purpose: Bind port.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BIND_HOST
variables.purpose: Bind interface. A non-loopback bind also needs SENTINEL_ALLOW_EXPOSURE and a credential (or the named unauthenticated opt-in); otherwise startup is refused.

variables.name: SENTINEL_ALLOW_EXPOSURE
variables.purpose: Explicit operator authorisation for a reachable bind.

variables.name: SENTINEL_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_EXPOSURE
variables.purpose: Named read-only-demo opt-out for a reachable bind with no credential; execution stays authenticated and dry-run.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BASIC_AUTH_USER
variables.purpose: Operator login for authenticated execution.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BASIC_AUTH_PASS
variables.purpose: Operator password for authenticated execution; unset fails closed with 503.

variables.name: PARTNERS_BASIC_AUTH_USER
variables.purpose: Shared operator credential pair accepted as an alternative to SENTINEL_BASIC_AUTH_*.

variables.name: PARTNERS_BASIC_AUTH_PASS
variables.purpose: Password half of the shared operator credential pair.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BLOCK_ENABLED
variables.purpose: Without it an authenticated execution is a dry run.

variables.name: EDGE_SENTINEL_DEMO
variables.purpose: Opt-in fixture core (P4): reads come from synthetic RFC 5737 data, and no external side effect is performed - block_ip/unblock_ip/cscli refuse at core and NetBird, Portabase, deploy-scan, Wazuh, ClamAV and the model are held back too, so demo mode reads no external service and changes none. /health reports the scope as demo.scopes. Grants no exposure and no exemption from the bind, exposure and credential rules.

variables.name: EDGE_SENTINEL_DEMO_SCENARIO
variables.purpose: Which fixture story to serve: mixed, or unavailable so LAPI reads fail and KPIs report 'not read'; an unknown value falls back to mixed.

variables.name: SENTINEL_PROTECTED_IPS
variables.purpose: Addresses/CIDRs that are never banned.

variables.name: SENTINEL_HOST_IPS
variables.purpose: This host's own addresses, treated as protected.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BLOCK_ALLOW_NETWORKS
variables.purpose: CIDRs inside which private/reserved space may be banned; loopback, link-local, multicast and unspecified are never bannable.

variables.name: SENTINEL_BLOCK_ALLOW_WIDE_CIDR
variables.purpose: Allow ranges wider than /24 (IPv4) or /64 (IPv6).

variables.name: SENTINEL_BLOCK_MAX_HOURS
variables.purpose: Cap on a ban duration.

variables.name: SENTINEL_STATE_DIR
variables.purpose: Directory for the durable approval state; unset keeps state in memory, an unreadable file fails closed.

variables.name: CROWDSEC_MACHINE_ID
variables.purpose: CrowdSec watcher (machine) login name; with the password it moves the alert read and the ban write onto the LAPI (no docker).

variables.name: CROWDSEC_MACHINE_PASSWORD
variables.purpose: Password of the CrowdSec watcher login; also accepted from CROWDSEC_MACHINE_PASSWORD_FILE.

variables.name: SENTINEL_REQUIRE_AUTH
variables.purpose: Standalone profile: every route except /health and /readyz needs the operator credential, and startup is refused without one.

variables.name: SENTINEL_TENANT
variables.purpose: Organisation name shown in the dashboard; unset shows no name.

variables.name: WAZUH_TLS_VERIFY
variables.purpose: Certificate verification for the Wazuh API; a path uses that CA bundle, `off` skips verification and is labelled as such.

variables.name: DOCKER_CMD
variables.purpose: Docker command prefix for cscli exec. An operator escalation wrapper must use sudo -n: the app enforces that instead of ever prompting on a request path.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_LLM_BASE_URL
variables.purpose: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the optional triage narration. Empty means no model call at all. The kernel also requires the host to be private, loopback or link-local (or allowlisted) and treats it as absent otherwise.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_LLM_MODEL
variables.purpose: Model identifier sent to the operator's own configured endpoint. It names the request; it does not establish which model answers.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_LLM_IN_BOUNDARY_HOSTS
variables.purpose: Allowlist by which an operator declares a host in-boundary; using it for a publicly reachable host puts that claim on the operator.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_LLM_SETTINGS_FILE
variables.purpose: JSON file holding the endpoint, model and a non-secret key reference instead of the environment.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_LLM_TIMEOUT
variables.purpose: Seconds allowed for the model request.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.purpose: Bearer token sent to the operator's own configured endpoint - the OpenAI-compatible wire format, not a subscription to any vendor.

variables.name: REDEVOPS_PRIVACY_MODE
variables.purpose: Kernel-wide routing mode. The app's narration call registers only the in-boundary endpoint, so no external endpoint is a candidate for it in any mode.

model_narration.doc: Verified behaviour of the optional `triage` narration blurb. The README's prose is checked against these values so a claim here and a claim there cannot drift apart.
model_narration.candidate_endpoints: exactly one: the endpoint derived from REDEVOPS_LLM_BASE_URL
model_narration.fail_closed: no endpoint, a host the kernel will not treat as in-boundary, a refused route or a transport error all return None and the deterministic summary stands
model_narration.content_sent: a one-sentence instruction plus up to six active decision values with their scenario and severity
